title: 電子工学
subtitle: Introduction to Semiconductor Devices
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn an overview of the electronic and optical devises consisting semiconductor materials. (2) learn basic characteristics of the pn junction diode, the bipolar junction transistor, and the field effect transistor. (3) learn applications of semiconductor devices.
advice: This is a basic course of semiconductor devices. We will cover the following materials: 1. Fundamentals of semiconductor materials Classical quantum theory Energy band Electron and hole n-type and p-type semiconductors 2. Fundamentals of pn junction diode Structure, characteristics, and applications of pn junction diode 3. Fundamentals of bipolar junction transistor (BJT) Structure, characteristics, and applications of BJT 4. Fundamentals of field effect transistor (FET) Characteristics of Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (MOS) capacitor Structure, characteristics, and applications of MOSFET
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of classical mechanics Acquisition of electromagnetics I Basic skill of mathematics (especially differential / integral)

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain an overview of the classical quantum theory and characteristics of semiconductor materials.
Be able to explain the structure, characteristics, and applications of the pn junction diode.
Be able to explain the structure, characteristics, and applications of the BJT.
Be able to explain the structure, characteristics, and applications of the MOSFET.
